review.rationale: The supplied Gold is a coherent independent pre-candidate expectation. REQ-001 and AC-001–AC-003 match the original PRD and supplied source: limitFunction already shares one internal limiter and forwards clearQueue, but does not expose its counts in either the runtime wrapper or its return declaration. The exact four-file binding scope covers the implementation, maintained declaration, runtime regressions and tsd regressions without requiring unrelated configuration changes or gratuitous edits. Stable requirement, acceptance and task keys are preserved. The original task expectations require implementation and independent verification, with verification dependent on implementation and both relationships covering every required acceptance criterion. Blocked readiness at assignments, with separate abstained-no-eligible reasons for both tasks, is appropriate: the only project member is a non-auto-assignable reviewer with no execution capability claims. That active, independently configured reviewer can satisfy the supplied earlier scenario-review prerequisite without becoming an eligible implementer or verifier. No unresolved material business decision is supplied, so an earlier decision block is not warranted. Repository identity, base commit, file fingerprints and the Gold/preview release-input fingerprints are consistent as supplied, including source, team, decision, prompt, model, sampling and policy identifiers. I relied on the Service's stated mechanical digest binding; I did not recompute digests, execute code, infer human attestation or use candidate outputs. The outstanding negative-control operations concern subsequent benchmark validation, not an inconsistency in this proposed expectation.
